title: Hope after leaving the familiar behind

captions.energy: Hurrying the end of former routines
captions.emotions: Hoping for a freer new arrangement

meaning: A new domestic routine gives hope support when leaving the old behind does not outpace creating comforts available to you both.
text: You can arrange domestic life through a clear sequence: understanding needs, clearing room and dividing the work. The Emperor in the physical position of Muladhara describes giving change a practical form. Death in energy tests your footing through wanting the old routine finished quickly, leaving little transition time. The Star in emotions hopes for a freer space that suits two people. Hope helps you see something good ahead, yet cannot itself create the daily conveniences that disappeared with the previous arrangement.

For example, you remove a bulky wardrobe to make the room brighter. There is more space, while clothes temporarily remain on chairs and new storage still needs choosing. **Hope for space also needs comfort this morning.** Simple temporary storage lets you feel the benefit of the cleared room. The picture of a new home then supports real life instead of asking you to bear daily inconvenience until the whole idea is achieved.

The difficulty is treating an intermediate answer as going backwards. Wanting a clean new beginning postpones even a simple convenience until the ideal option appears. Hope stays bright while everyday use of home grows tiring. Practical order connects transition with the future when it does not require either keeping everything old or immediately living within an entirely finished new form. Both the present and what you want next can then have room.
